stem.text: The diagram shows the possible organisation of DNA molecules after one replication.

stem.alt: Diagram of one parent DNA strand shown as a pair of bars, with arrows leading to four options A to D, each showing a pair of bars with shaded and unshaded parts.

A.alt: Two pairs of vertical bars, each bar with shaded and unshaded parts.

B.alt: Two pairs of vertical bars, each bar with shaded and unshaded parts.

C.alt: Two pairs of vertical bars, each bar with shaded and unshaded parts.

D.alt: Two pairs of vertical bars, each bar with shaded and unshaded parts.
